statement: theorem benchmark_positive_minimum (D S : ℝ) (hD : 0 < D) (hS : 0 < S) : 0 < D / Real.sqrt S ∧ BanditRL.OnlineOptimalStep.upperBound (D ^ 2) S (D / Real.sqrt S) = D * Real.sqrt S ∧ ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → D * Real.sqrt S ≤ BanditRL.OnlineOptimalStep.upperBound (D ^ 2) S η ∧ (BanditRL.OnlineOptimalStep.upperBound (D ^ 2) S η = D * Real.sqrt S ↔ η = D / Real.sqrt S)
